conflicts.permit: Creating profiles of types of users by combining user data with information from BNEA advertising partners, providing the data to our group companies, ad agencies and ad platforms to target advertisements of BNEA (and its group company) games and services to you outside of this service, and otherwise performing advertising analytics and performance metrics
conflicts.prohibit: BNEA has not “sold” or “shared” Personal Data for purposes of California Privacy Laws.
conflicts.situation: Sharing user personal data with ad platforms and agencies for cross-context behavioral or targeted advertising under California Privacy Laws.
conflicts.reason: Disclosing personal data to ad platforms for targeted advertising constitutes 'sharing' under CPRA, yet the policy explicitly denies having 'shared' personal data.
